title: Bounded production preparation and reading costs
question: What do bounded production-only measurements establish about reading reuse, startup and archive payload size?
method: Run production import and rendition/span-reading functions on original source bytes; compare same-process cold/warm reading; inspect installed interfaces and archived byte sizes read-only.

outputs.role: Raw measurements, profiles, hardware and interface observations

conclusion: Bounded startup, archive-size and cold/warm page observations established. Existing parsing memo is effective. Profile instrumentation changes timeout-sensitive behavior, preventing reliable quantitative stage attribution; no replacement speedup or full production throughput established.
